title: 第13章 位面之子叶辰第14章 凌浩降临真龙秘境
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 随着真武圣地覆灭的消息不断向外扩散，剩余的三大圣地都选择了封山，不得任何弟子进出，违者杀无赦
与此同时在真武大陆的一处虚空之上，一座金碧辉煌的宫殿中
“神子，真武圣地中除了两个外出历练回来的弟子之外，已全部尽诛，”
帝一单膝下跪恭敬的道
“嗯，做的很好”
凌浩坐在主座上轻声道
对于凌浩为什么放这两个弟子是因为在前世他们两个在一次历练中结实了位面之子叶辰，而后向圣地引荐，最后带领真武圣地成为真武大陆中唯一的一个圣地
所有凌浩放了这两个就是用做跟踪器，现在的凌浩根本不知道叶辰在什么地方，所以希望这两个跟踪器找到叶辰
“帝二，你扩散神识看看这两个人往什么地方去了”
凌浩看着旁边的帝二轻声道
六十四帝卫修为最差的乃是大罗金仙境，最强乃是身为帝卫统领的帝一仙圣境，再后就是副统领帝二准仙圣境，一个准仙圣境的强者神识足以笼罩整个真武大陆
“回神子，这两个人好像是往一个秘境去了”
帝二恭敬的回道
“秘境？能知道是什么秘境吗”
凌浩顿时来了兴趣，秘境可是有着大机缘的地方，一但秘境出世势必会引起血一般的战争，死亡人数不计其数
“回神子，好像是埋葬一只天仙境真龙的地方，不知道是被何方的强者藏进这个秘境之中”
帝二神识笼罩整个真武大陆道，而后将神识伸进秘境之中，探索一下
“哦，真龙秘境吗？这就有意思了，想必叶辰的真龙之体就是从这边得到的吧”
凌浩摸着下巴暗道
前世叶辰的真龙之体可谓是所向无敌，给了叶辰越界挑战的资本，更是成为上界碾压一代天骄的绝世天才
“现在的叶辰也不过是炼气期的蝼蚁，那么我夺了叶辰的机缘自己吸收”
凌浩笑着暗道
凌浩天生就是混沌青莲体乃是先天极境，出生之日就掌握了一百万斤的恐怖实力
炼气期又称炼体，乃是修炼之中的基础
炼气十重划分为，初期：炼皮，炼肉，炼筋，中期：铭骨，铭腑，铭脏，高级炼体：化血，化脉
最后突破炼气极境一百万斤
“帝二，你通知家族那边，准备最好的修炼资源然后弄过来”
凌浩吩咐帝二道，随后打开水晶镜，而后水晶镜显现的是一座秘境，秘境之外站满了修士，并且还有源源不断的增加人数，真武圣地幸存的两名弟子也在，不过已经换了另一种行头，不再是真武圣地的专属道袍
“是，神子”
而后帝二，吩咐另一个金甲帝卫返回家族一趟
“走，我们去这个真龙秘境玩玩，说不定里面有我的机缘呢哼哼”
凌浩笑着的道，而后回到主座上
“是神子”
随着帝一的声音落下，整个宫殿以极快的速度赶往真龙秘境
真龙秘境外
人山人海，四处都是高阶修士，普遍都是金丹期，元婴期，筑基期，还有少量的炼气期，修为较高的修士屹立在虚空之上，等待秘境的开启
秘境外的一个角落处，一个男子靠着树边，他五官清秀，身材挺拔，体格健壮，面孔晒的黝黑，两只眼睛深渊而明亮，犹如星辰般闪烁着亮光
content_en:
As news of the destruction of Zhenwu Holy Land continues to spread, the remaining three holy places have chosen to close their mountains. No disciples are allowed to enter or exit. Violators will be killed without mercy.
At the same time, in a void in Zhenwu Continent, in a magnificent palace
"Son of God, except for the two disciples who returned from training in Zhenwu Holy Land, all of them have been killed."
Di Yi knelt down on one knee and said respectfully
"Yeah, well done."
Ling Hao sat on the main seat and said softly
As for why Ling Hao let these two disciples go, it was because in their previous life, the two of them met Ye Chen, the son of the plane, during an experience, and then introduced him to the Holy Land, and finally led the Zhenwu Holy Land to become the only Holy Land in the Zhenwu Continent.
So Ling Hao put these two as trackers. Now Ling Hao has no idea where Ye Chen is, so he hopes these two trackers can find Ye Chen.
"Di Er, spread your consciousness and see where these two people have gone."
Ling Hao looked at Di Er beside him and said softly
Among the sixty-four imperial guards, the one with the lowest cultivation level is the Daluo Jin Immortal Realm. The strongest one is the Emperor's First Immortal Realm who is the commander of the Imperial Guard. The second is the Deputy Commander, the Second Quasi-Immortal Realm. The consciousness of a strong man in the Quasi-Immortal Realm is enough to cover the entire Zhenwu Continent.
"Back to Shenzi, these two people seem to have gone to a secret realm."
Emperor Er replied respectfully
"Secret realm? Do you know what secret realm it is?"
Ling Hao suddenly became interested. The secret realm is a place with great opportunities. Once the secret realm comes out, it will inevitably cause a bloody war, with countless deaths.
"Returning to the Son of God, it seems to be the place where a real dragon from the Celestial Realm is buried. I don't know where a strong person hid it in this secret realm."
Emperor Er's consciousness enveloped the entire Zhenwu Continent, and then he extended his consciousness into the secret realm to explore
"Oh, the True Dragon Secret Realm? This is interesting. Ye Chen must have obtained the True Dragon's body from here."
Ling Hao touched his chin and said to himself
In his previous life, Ye Chen's true dragon body was invincible. It gave Ye Chen the capital to cross the border and challenge him, and he became a peerless genius who could crush a generation of geniuses in the upper world.
"Now Ye Chen is just an ant in the Qi refining stage, so I took away Ye Chen's opportunity and absorbed it myself."
Ling Hao smiled and secretly said
Ling Hao was born with a chaotic green lotus body and was in the extreme innate state. He mastered the terrifying strength of one million kilograms on the day he was born.
The Qi refining period is also called body refining, which is the foundation of cultivation.
The ten levels of Qi refining are divided into: initial stage: skin refining, meat refining, tendon refining, middle stage: inscription of bones, inscription of fu organs, inscription of viscera, advanced body refining: transformation of blood, transformation of meridians
Finally broke through the ultimate level of Qi refining to weigh one million kilograms
"Di Er, please inform the family to prepare the best training resources and get them over."
Ling Hao ordered Emperor Erdao, and then opened the crystal mirror, and what was revealed in the crystal mirror was a secret realm. Outside the secret realm, there were monks standing, and the number of people was increasing continuously. The two surviving disciples of the Zhenwu Holy Land were also there, but they had changed their outfits and were no longer the exclusive robes of the Zhenwu Holy Land.
"Yes, Son of God"
Then Emperor Er ordered another golden-armored imperial guard to return to his family.
"Let's go to this real dragon secret realm. Maybe there will be a chance for me in it."
Ling Hao said with a smile, and then returned to the main seat.
"He is the Son of God"
As Di Yi's voice fell, the entire palace rushed to the True Dragon Secret Realm at an extremely fast speed.
True Dragon's Secret Realm
There are huge crowds of people, and there are high-level monks everywhere. They are generally in the Golden elixir stage, Nascent Soul stage, Foundation building stage, and a small amount of Qi refining stage. The monks with higher cultivation level are standing in the void, waiting for the opening of the secret realm.
In a corner outside the secret realm, a man was leaning against a tree. He had delicate features, a tall and strong body, a tanned face, and two eyes that were deep and bright, shining like stars.
title_en: Chapter 13: Ye Chen, Son of the Plane Chapter 14: Ling Hao comes to the True Dragon Secret Realm
